nodes.name: 6.2.1 Trigger - Onboarding Complete
nodes.notes: 6.2.1.1 (part 1). Meant to be called from Module 2.7 (Client Onboarding) at the point it finishes creating the Nextcloud folder / Odoo Project / Discuss channel. Per the precedent already flagged in this file's own §10A.3 for 2.6->2.7 ('the Execute Workflow node from 2.6 into 2.7 must be added manually - it does not exist by default'), the same applies here: add an Execute Workflow node at the end of 2.7 pointing at this workflow. Not done silently since 2.7 is an already-built Phase 2 module.

nodes.name: Wait X Days (placeholder = 7)
nodes.notes: 6.2.1.1 (part 2). 'X-din Wait node' - the exact number of days isn't specified anywhere in the uploads (Stage 44 / Customer Success Planning has no automation.md yet, per §16.0). 7 days is a placeholder giving the client a short settling-in period before the checklist lands; flag for Nivy confirmation, not a sourced business rule.

parameters.query:
-- guard against duplicate checklist creation if this workflow is ever re-triggered for the same client
SELECT adoption_checklist_created_at FROM clients_master WHERE id = {{ $json.client_id }};

nodes.name: Odoo Project task-create
nodes.notes: 6.2.1.2 (part 2). Same execute_kw / project.task create pattern already used by Module 2.7 for its 6 starter tasks (§10A.3) - reused, not reinvented. One call per checklist item (n8n loops over the items from the previous node automatically).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow_name, execution_id, node_name, error_message, input_payload)
VALUES ('6.2.1 - Adoption Checklist Auto-Create', '{{ $execution.id }}', 'Odoo Project task-create', {{ JSON.stringify($json.error) }}, {{ JSON.stringify($json) }}::jsonb);

subSteps.6.2.1.1: Trigger: onboarding-complete + X-din Wait node -> 6.2.1 Trigger + Wait X Days (7-day cadence is placeholder) + idempotency guard (Check Not Already Created / Already Created?)
subSteps.6.2.1.2: Odoo Project task-create node (checklist items) -> Build Checklist Items + Odoo Project task-create + failure handling + Mark Checklist Created
